items.title: Bob Lovett Interview, 1949-04-01
items.q: Yes, Ellington and, uh, you know, I like all kinds of things.

ctx.x: Uh, do you go, uh, uh, uh, do you cover a broader span? Do you listen to Ellington or do you listen to...
Oh, yes, yes. Yes, Ellington and, uh, you know, I like all kinds of things. I collect tapes of the Mills Blue Rhythm Orchestra and all.
Mainly, uh, instrumental. Uh, yes, but some vocal stuff.
